title: REQ · Canvas objectClick events select the object and open the ActionMenu
summary: App subscribes to the typed objectClick event so canvas clicks replace the removed hotspot buttons.
description: Context: BootScene emits phaserToReact 'objectClick' {id}, but nothing in src consumes it; selection currently comes only from SceneView buttons calling setSelectedId. Desired behavior: App subscribes to phaserToReact.on('objectClick') and calls setSelectedId(id), unsubscribing on unmount. Expected result: a canvas click opens the ActionMenu for that object. Why: interactions must keep updating real game state after the HTML hotspots are gone.
acceptance_criteria: Given the App is mounted, when phaserToReact emits objectClick with id bookshelf, then the ActionMenu shows the bookshelf actions.
Given the App is unmounted, when objectClick is emitted afterwards, then no handler runs and no React state update warning occurs.
Given the ActionMenu is open, when an action is chosen, then game state updates through useGame.act as before.
technical_constraints: Use the existing phaserToReact bus and its on() unsubscribe function
definition_of_done: Subscription added before the early return so hook order is stable
